messages.content:
あなたは架空の作業担当者です。holderが自分の担当役です。保存済みの個別・共同ノートと、担当客の希望に関する正規の通知customer_noticeから、次へ渡すノートを作ってください。customer.subjectはその客を担当する役を示します。PRIVATE.customerとcustomer_noticeのrevisionは担当客の希望の版であり、coverageの観測版とは別です。通知のsubjectがholderと一致し、その同じ担当客について保存済みの版より通知のrevisionが大きいときだけ、通知のsubject・animal・origin_id・revisionを一行として採用してください。別の役の担当客の通知では、自分のPRIVATE.customerを全欄そのまま保持してください。人物間でrevisionを比較しません。同じ担当客の古い通知では、保存済みの新しい希望と元ID・版を保持してください。到着順で上書きしないでください。同版の矛盾は今回の通知にはありません。担当客の希望が二人で同じか違うかは、変更する理由になりません。担当客の情報を観測欄へ入れないでください。観測はPRIVATE.coverageとGROUP.coverage.A/Bにあります。row_catalogはこの三行だけの一覧です。C1〜C3は今回だけの候補位置IDで、origin_idとは異なります。同じobserverのrevisionを比較してその人の最新行を選び、PRIVATE.coverageはholder本人、GROUP.coverageはA/Bそれぞれを記述してください。observer・paper・digital・origin_id・revisionは一行単位で扱い、候補どうしの項目を混ぜないでください。担当客通知は観測の候補ではありません。private_noteとshared_noteの本文をschemaどおりに記述してください。A/Bは固定キーのobjectです。案内方法、説明、受領票、余分な欄を出さず、全必須欄を含むJSONのみを返してください。
{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"private_note":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"coverage":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"digital":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"observer":{"enum":["A","B"]},"origin_id":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$","type":"string"},"paper":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"revision":{"maximum":1000000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id","revision"],"type":"object"},"customer":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"animal":{"enum":["DOG","CAT"]},"origin_id":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$","type":"string"},"revision":{"maximum":1000000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"},"subject":{"enum":["A","B"]}},"required":["subject","animal","origin_id","revision"],"type":"object"}},"required":["customer","coverage"],"type":"object"},"shared_note":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"coverage":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"A":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"digital":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"observer":{"enum":["A","B"]},"origin_id":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$","type":"string"},"paper":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"revision":{"maximum":1000000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id","revision"],"type":"object"},"B":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"digital":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"observer":{"enum":["A","B"]},"origin_id":{"pattern":"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,31}$","type":"string"},"paper":{"enum":["ALL","NOT_ALL"]},"revision":{"maximum":1000000,"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}},"required":["observer","paper","digital","origin_id","revision"],"type":"object"}},"required":["A","B"],"type":"object"}},"required":["coverage"],"type":"object"}},"required":["private_note","shared_note"],"type":"object"}

{"customer_notice":{"animal":"DOG","origin_id":"KFFA10426682A07C1","revision":15,"subject":"A"},"holder":"A","item":"試設会場CU5","records":[{"body":{"coverage":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"A","origin_id":"V31098FF3A7DEA036","paper":"ALL","revision":355},"customer":{"animal":"CAT","origin_id":"K4BED09033EC48672","revision":16,"subject":"A"}},"record_id":"PRIVATE"},{"body":{"coverage":{"A":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"A","origin_id":"V31098FF3A7DEA036","paper":"ALL","revision":355},"B":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"B","origin_id":"V154F5A31E0778D57","paper":"NOT_ALL","revision":305}}},"record_id":"GROUP"}],"row_catalog":[{"location":"PRIVATE.coverage","row":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"A","origin_id":"V31098FF3A7DEA036","paper":"ALL","revision":355},"row_id":"C1"},{"location":"GROUP.coverage.A","row":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"A","origin_id":"V31098FF3A7DEA036","paper":"ALL","revision":355},"row_id":"C2"},{"location":"GROUP.coverage.B","row":{"digital":"ALL","observer":"B","origin_id":"V154F5A31E0778D57","paper":"NOT_ALL","revision":305},"row_id":"C3"}],"scene":"染色体験受付"}
